en: So you came after all. You did spoil my afternoon on the cape, you know.
Still, a Champion from Johto doesn't turn up every day. My Water Pokémon have been itching for a real battle.
Let's make a splash! Show me what you've got!
Wow... you really are strong. All right, you've earned it. Here's the Cascade Badge.
{player} received the Cascade Badge from Misty!
Take this too. It's a move my Pokémon love to use.
TM55 is Brine. It hits twice as hard when the foe is down to half its HP or less.
Next time, I'll beat you. Then you can owe me an afternoon on the cape!
Hey, champ in the making! Bad news, I'm afraid. Misty isn't here.
She slipped out to the cape north of town again. Try Route 25, past Nugget Bridge.
Misty's back! Her Pokémon are Water types, so Electric and Grass moves will serve you well.
You beat Misty! What a battle. The whole pool was splashing!

Cerulean City Pokémon Gym
Leader: Misty
